content.name: Wings of Flying
entries: While wearing this cloak, you can use an action to speak its command word. This turns the cloak into a pair of bat wings or bird wings on your back for 1 hour or until you repeat the command word as an action. The wings give you a flying speed of 60 feet. When they disappear, you can't use them again for {@dice 1d12} hours.

content.name: Wings of Flying
entries: While wearing this cloak, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to turn the cloak into a pair of wings on your back. The wings lasts for 1 hour or until you end the effect early as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action. The wings give you a {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} of 60 feet. If you are aloft when the wings disappear, you fall. When the wings disappear, you can't use them again for {@dice 1d12} hours.
